From: Lydia Park <l.park@summitgrid.io>

Subject: Vendor initiation — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessor list and PO routing

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. SummitGrid is ready to begin vendor setup so we can schedule a pilot in late July. Procurement needs the following to complete the vendor record and to issue a PO:

- Executed DPA (standard SummitGrid DPA will be routed for signature)
- SOC 2 Type II report (or a public link to your attestation)
- Current subprocessor list and any planned changes in the next 90 days
- W-9 or equivalent tax/billing docs
- PO routing instructions (email, portal, required invoice fields)

Can you confirm which of the above you can provide today and whether the DPA can be executed electronically (DocuSign)? Also please let me know the expected lead time for an executed DPA and a copy/link to SOC 2.

We'll also need a primary billing contact and the legal entity name that should appear on the PO. If there are any unusual terms (data residency, subprocessors of concern), flag them so we can escalate.

Appreciate it — cc'ing Alan in purchasing.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Senior Procurement Manager
SummitGrid
procurement@summitgrid.io

--

Lydia — great to meet you this morning. Welcome — excited to get SummitGrid set up.

Quick answers up front:
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA draft (PDF). We can do DocuSign; I've requested legal to generate a DocuSign envelope and will share the link when ready.
- SOC 2: public attestation link below (our auditor publishes a redacted public page).
- Subprocessors: attached CSV with current subprocessors and last-update date.
- W-9: attached W-9 (PDF) for Redwood, Inc.
- PO routing: we support email PO to accounting@redwood.ai or Ariba punchout. Required invoice fields: PO number, invoice number, invoice date, line-item description and total. Our accounting prefers PDF invoices emailed, cc'ing billing@redwood.ai.

I've looped in Marissa (sales ops) for PO routing and Karthik (legal) for any DPA redlines. If you prefer, we can accept the SummitGrid DPA instead of ours — legal will review.

Links / quick references:
- SOC 2 report (public): https://docs.redwood.ai/soc2/redwood-soc2-2028.html
- Subprocessors list: attached (redwood_subprocessors_list_2028-06.csv)

Next steps:
1) I'll upload our DPA draft to DocuSign and send you the signing link.
2) Marissa will confirm the billing contact and whether we should expect a SummitGrid PO number format.
3) Karthik will note any legal items.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks Jordan — that's helpful. A couple clarifying items from purchasing: 

- Billing contact: please confirm the name, email and the legal entity for invoicing exactly as it should appear on the PO. SummitGrid requires entity + remit address to be on the PO.
- PO number format: we use SG-###### (6-digit). Will you accept that as the PO reference on invoices?
- If you can, please set 'redwood.ai' as the remit domain in the invoice email so our AP automation picks it up.
- DocuSign: yes, please send the envelope. We'll need to review redlines within two business days. If Redwood prefers its DPA over SummitGrid's standard DPA, please note any substitutes in the signature block.

Also: are there any subprocessors that currently store SummitGrid user content outside of the US? We need to know for data residency reasons.

If everything looks good we'll issue a non-binding PO for pilot capacity once the DPA is signed.

Best,
Lydia
